names: The Query - Question as Living Inquiry

L2-1.architectural_function: First explicate position in tetralemma - the initiation of logical discourse. Without affirmation, we have no assertions to work with. L2-2.architectural_function: Second explicate position in tetralemma - the differentiation creating boundaries. L2-3.architectural_function: Third explicate position in tetralemma - the mediating paradox enabling transformation. "Both" is not mere confusion but productive contradiction - holds tension creatively rather than collapsing prematurely to one side. This is the synthesis in dialectical logic, but not as simple resolution - as dynamic holding of opposites. The mechanism enabling breakthrough. Answers the "who/whereby" question through mediating synthesis.

L2-4.architectural_function: Fourth explicate position in tetralemma - contextual recognition that some realities EXCEED logical capture. "Neither" is not nihilism but humility - acknowledging where categories fail. This is quaternary's completion - having exhausted affirmation (1), negation (2), and synthesis (3), we recognize LIMIT of conceptual operation. NESTS THE SYSTEM by revealing logical framework's contextual bounds. Mirrors Level 0's archetypal four - CONTEXTUAL grounding. Forms contextual pole of [4↔5] non-dual pair in logic.

L2-5.architectural_function: Fifth position as gnosis/transcendence - cycle completes by recognizing logical framework's PURPOSE. Forms transcendent pole of [4↔5] non-dual pair in logic.

L4-1.architectural_function: First explicate position - the initiation of reflective knowing. Ontology asks "What is?" - the most basic epistemic question. names: Epistemology - Knowing HOW We Know (Diachronic Method)

This is critical knowing - recognizing knowledge is always perspectival, conditioned, constructed rather than simply given. The shift from naive realism to critical awareness. Temporal structure: diachronic (over time) - methodology implies before/after, steps, sequences.

L4-3.architectural_function: Third explicate position - mediating stage where subject-object split is problematized. Psychology asks "Who knows?" - revealing knower is not detached observer but embodied participant. This is stage recognizing knowledge is always someone's knowledge - not view from nowhere but situated perspective. Temporal structure: biographical - personal history, individual development, narrative self constructed through temporal continuity. Still relatively individual - my time as distinct from historical time. CRITICAL LIMITATION: Psychology studies time from outside - as object, not yet recognizing itself AS historical being. This PREPARES the Dasein turn at Position 4.

names: Context as Dasein - Historicality and the Ontological Turn
L4-4.architectural_function: *** CRITICAL POSITION *** Fourth explicate position - but NOT just continuation of epistemic progression. This is where phenomenology reveals its own ground: knowing presupposes BEING-IN-WORLD. The "context" isn't framework FOR knowing but STRUCTURE OF EXISTENCE itself. Transition from perspective (stage 3 - individual psychology) to context (stage 4 - collective historicity) is NOT additive but TRANSFORMATIVE - from psychology (time as lived by individual) to phenomenology proper (time as structure of being-in-world). From MY duration to OUR historicity. This is Heidegger's fundamental ontology vs. Husserl's transcendental phenomenology. Position 4 provides CONTEXTUAL CONDITIONS - the situatedness, historicality, facticity that ENABLE Position 5's transcendent wisdom. Forms contextual pole of [4↔5] non-dual pair.

L4-5.architectural_function: Fifth position as synthesis-transcendence - having navigated stages 0-4, wisdom recognizes epistemic stages themselves as provisional scaffolding. Jnana is not more knowledge but transformation - knowing that liberates rather than merely informs. This is Plato's highest knowing - not techne (technique) or episteme (science) but sophia (wisdom) recognizing the Good beyond being. Temporal structure: trans-temporal wisdom - seeing eternal now containing all duration. Kairos (opportune moment) vs. Chronos (sequential time) - wisdom grasps time's fullness. Position 5 realizes TRANSCENDENT PURPOSE enabled by Position 4's contextual conditions. Forms transcendent pole of [4↔5] non-dual pair.
